topics.title: The Tunnel (Part I): Suraj and the steam engine
topics.ncert_sections: The Tunnel, Part I: Let us read

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the imagery and figures of speech Ruskin Bond uses to describe the train, the tunnel and the jungle.
Explain what Suraj does at the tunnel and what it shows about his curious, adventurous nature.

topics.title: The Tunnel (Part I): Sunder Singh, the watchman
topics.ncert_sections: The Tunnel, Part I: Let us read, Let us discuss

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the watchman's day and night system for inspecting the tunnel and warning the engine driver.
Infer Sunder Singh's character from what he says about his tunnel, the jungle and the town.

topics.title: The Tunnel (Part II): The leopard and the night mail
topics.ncert_sections: The Tunnel, Part II: Let us read, Let us think and reflect

concepts.learning_objective: Recall and explain how Sunder Singh and Suraj drive the leopard out of the tunnel before the night mail.
Interpret the ending of the story and why Sunder Singh is called a 'firefly'.

topics.title: The Tunnel: sound words, 'would' and 'used to', colon and semicolon
topics.ncert_sections: The Tunnel: Let us learn I-IV

concepts.learning_objective: Match sound words from the story with their meanings and use them in sentences.
Use 'would' and 'used to' correctly to describe habits and states in the past.
Use the colon and the semicolon correctly in sentences.

topics.title: Travel (poem by Edna St. Vincent Millay)
topics.ncert_sections: Travel: Let us read, Let us discuss, Let us think and reflect

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the speaker's longing for travel and the meaning of key lines of the poem.
Identify the rhyme scheme, personification and imagery used in the poem.

topics.title: Travel: words for sounds and the soft and hard 'c'
topics.ncert_sections: Travel: Let us learn II, Let us speak

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish words for related sounds such as wailing, bawling, whimpering and hollering.
Apply the rule for pronouncing the letter 'c' as a soft /s/ or a hard /k/ sound.

topics.title: Conquering the Summit: Arunima Sinha's journey
topics.ncert_sections: Conquering the Summit: Let us read, Let us discuss

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the main events of Arunima Sinha's journey from her accident to the Seven Summits.
Evaluate Arunima Sinha's message about goals, failure and resilience.

topics.title: Conquering the Summit: phrases, word forms and articles
topics.ncert_sections: Conquering the Summit: Let us learn I-III

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the meanings of phrases such as 'beacon of hope' and 'mental fortitude' in context.
Identify the noun, adjective, verb and adverb forms of words from the text.
Use the articles 'a', 'an' and 'the' correctly, and recognise where no article is needed.
